parent_mapping.method: Mechanical parent mapping: a CLI option/positional belongs to its command family (nearest existing cli: row); a CLI alias to its target; a model/provider entry to model/proxy_providers; a plugin asset/API/test/manifest to its plugin; an OpenClaw extension to the audited OC-* capability of its name or first mapped manifest category; a workflow source file to its area capability; a dashboard component/dialog/form/nav to webui_status.  A surface is covered when it matches its own ledger row or its resolved parent row is IMPLEMENTED in the live ledger, so it must not create a standalone MISSING row.  Parented and distinct uncovered items are counted and listed separately.
